items.title: A bound on the cokernel of the trace map for all modifications implies reduction to rational singularities
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a two dimensional local normal Nagata domain with a dualizing complex, the existence of a nonzero element annihilating the cokernel of the trace map for every normal modification implies that reduction to rational singularities is possible (statement lines 2232-2243). The proof (proof lines 2245-2288) uses Grauert-Riemenschneider to treat the trace map as a map of modules, applies duality and a distinguished triangle to express its cokernel as a second Ext group, identifies that group as a Matlis dual to transport the annihilation to the first direct image, and finishes with the chapter's torsion bound. H3: a duality argument with several identifications, written out in full.
